name: Succubus' Lunch: A Suffering Pulp
source:
"You are a succubus feeding on human souls blooming inside them like lush fruit. There are plenty of factors affecting their taste: what this person has been through and where they are now, what is hidden deep within their hearts and what you can pull out from there. Try talking to these souls. Perhaps you can add some sweetness to their flesh and mind before you devour them until there's nothing left."

[From [url=https://andrey-martz.itch.io/succubus-lunch]Itch.io[/url]]
